attendance.note: Organiser-reported '13.000 asistentes en sus últimas ediciones' (13,000 attendees at its latest editions, held before a six-year break). Edition year not stated; not a 2026 count.

add_sources.note: Site 'Lleva tu marca' section: '13.000 asistentes en sus últimas ediciones'. Estación Mapocho page says ExpoYoga returns 'después de seis años'.
Call for exhibitors: brands and projects in wellness, yoga or movement should write to stands@expoyoga.cl. Site FAQ says brands take part by booking a stand via Passline.
Cabify code EXPOYOGA gives 50% off two rides to and from the venue on 17 and 18 Oct ('CABIFY está con nosotros').
'CONCURSO EXPOYOGA x ECOYOGA PATAGONIA': joint giveaway of VIP and general tickets plus an eco mat carrier.
Portalyoga (yoga and sports store) and Mahatma Yoga Studio co-author many organiser posts, including this exhibitor call; role not stated.
Centro Cultural Estación Mapocho is venue and co-author on 25 organiser posts.
Google snippet: Radio Pauta gave away five double tickets to ExpoYoga 2026.
